name: rain-glass-background
title: Rain Glass Background
description: A tall window pane with a photo behind fogged glass, dotted with water droplets that gather, run and merge. Pressing and dragging wipes a clear streak through the fog that slowly clouds over again.
use: A travel, cabin or hotel hero wants atmosphere and a tactile reason for visitors to touch the screen.
avoid: It needs WebGL2 and a CORS-readable photo, and on touch the vertical drag also scrolls the page.
a11y: Reduced motion stops the loop on one static frame, but the wipe is pointer-only and only the headline is meaningful content. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A full-bleed dusk view of dark hills and water, softened by haze and speckled with round droplets of different sizes, some dragging thin trails. Centred white text and two small calls to action sit over it.
behaves: Droplets land, grow heavy and run down the pane, leaving thin clear trails, while the fog thickens back over time. Dragging across the glass wipes a broad clear band that removes the drops under the hand and then slowly fogs up again.
customise: Choose the photo with src, the headline with title, rain from 0 to 1, and disable wiping with interactive. Children replace the default paragraph and links.
weight: heavy: A WebGL2 fragment shader redrawn every frame plus two 2D canvases for drops and fog.
